title: AdCP Trust Record — Sells-For Sub-document
description: PROPOSAL (RFC #7809) — not part of the published protocol. Bulk supply-side acknowledgements referenced from adcp-trust.json sells_for_url, for networks and SSPs that acknowledge thousands of publisher grants. Kept off the signature-verification fetch path. Every entry follows the same rules as adcp-trust.json sells_for[]: agent_url MUST be an agents[] entry in the referencing adcp-trust.json, and terms come only from the publisher's adagents.json. Removing an entry withdraws the acknowledgement; verifiers SHOULD apply the same retention semantics adagents.json uses for revoked publisher domains before treating a removal as permanent.

next.description: Optional same-host URL of the next shard. Verifiers follow shards in order and stop at a configured limit.
